cases.title: Complete data descriptor
cases.target: A complete descriptor can be inspected only after handling possible absence.
cases.principledRepair: Handle undefined and inspect attributes explicitly.
cases.weakRepair: Assert the descriptor exists without establishing the property.

cases.title: Descriptor writable must be Boolean
cases.target: PropertyDescriptor.writable is Boolean, not a descriptive string.
cases.principledRepair: Use a Boolean and document the intended mutability.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the descriptor to PropertyDescriptor.

cases.title: Reflect own keys include symbols
cases.target: Reflect.ownKeys returns string and symbol keys.
cases.principledRepair: Model the result as PropertyKey values.
cases.weakRepair: Convert every key to string and lose symbol identity.

cases.title: Property key is not always string
cases.target: PropertyKey includes symbol as well as string/number source forms.
cases.principledRepair: Narrow with typeof before using string-only behavior.
cases.weakRepair: Call String(key) and pretend identity is preserved.

cases.title: Enumeration surfaces differ
cases.target: Object.keys and Reflect.ownKeys observe different property sets.
cases.principledRepair: Choose the surface that matches the claim.
cases.weakRepair: Use one enumeration API for every purpose.

cases.title: Spread invokes an enumerable getter
cases.target: Object spread reads enumerable property values and therefore invokes getters.
cases.principledRepair: Inspect descriptors or serialize an explicit plain snapshot.
cases.weakRepair: Wrap spread in catch and keep the effectful boundary.

cases.title: Symbol-keyed metadata is typed
cases.target: A unique symbol can name a statically tracked property.
cases.principledRepair: Keep the symbol identity in module scope and use it consistently.
cases.weakRepair: Replace it with a collision-prone string.

cases.title: Descriptor lookup may be absent
cases.target: Descriptor lookup returns undefined when the property is absent.
cases.principledRepair: Check for undefined before reading attributes.
cases.weakRepair: Use a non-null assertion without proving ownership.

cases.title: Inherited method uses derived receiver
cases.target: An inherited method receives the final base object as receiver.
cases.principledRepair: Type the receiver contract and construct the delegated object deliberately.
cases.weakRepair: Bind the method to the prototype object.

cases.title: Prototype object lacks instance field initialization
cases.target: TypeScript may type Constructor.prototype as the instance type even though instance fields are not installed there.
cases.principledRepair: Treat the prototype as shared behavior and construct a legitimate instance for instance state.
cases.weakRepair: Use a non-null assertion on the missing field.

cases.title: Own-property check precedes read
cases.target: Own input policy must be checked separately from inherited lookup.
cases.principledRepair: Use Object.hasOwn and then validate the value.
cases.weakRepair: Use the in operator for untrusted dictionaries.

cases.title: Explicit this contract rejects wrong receiver
cases.target: The receiver must satisfy the explicit this parameter.
cases.principledRepair: Pass a receiver with the required tenant property.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the receiver to Tenant.

cases.title: Inherited getter preserves receiver
cases.target: Accessor lookup changes objects but calls the getter with the original receiver.
cases.principledRepair: Preserve receiver semantics when forwarding with Reflect.get.
cases.weakRepair: Read the getter from the prototype with the prototype as receiver.

cases.title: Inherited input is rejected
cases.target: An inherited property is not an explicit input field under an own-only contract.
cases.principledRepair: Require Object.hasOwn and validate own data.
cases.weakRepair: Accept inherited values because the in operator succeeds.

cases.title: Null-prototype dictionary remains explicit
cases.target: A null-prototype dictionary avoids inherited string keys but still needs value validation.
cases.principledRepair: Construct it explicitly and use own-key operations.
cases.weakRepair: Assume null prototype provides runtime type safety.

cases.title: Prototype method needs declared receiver field
cases.target: The inferred receiver type contains no tenant property.
cases.principledRepair: Declare an explicit this contract or include the field in the object.
cases.weakRepair: Suppress noImplicitThis.

cases.title: Explicit receiver method call
cases.target: Method call syntax supplies a receiver satisfying the explicit this parameter.
cases.principledRepair: Keep receiver-dependent invocation visible.
cases.weakRepair: Remove the this contract.

cases.title: Extracted explicit-this method cannot be called bare
cases.target: A bare call has an undefined receiver in module code.
cases.principledRepair: Wrap or bind the method at the composition boundary.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the function to () => number.

cases.title: Arrow function is not constructible
cases.target: Arrow functions have no construct signature.
cases.principledRepair: Call it as a factory or use a constructible class/function.
cases.weakRepair: Cast it to a constructor type.

cases.title: Construct signature states construction
cases.target: Constructibility is represented by a new signature.
cases.principledRepair: Use a construct signature when construction is the required operation.
cases.weakRepair: Type constructors as Function.

cases.title: Bound constructor preserves prefix arguments
cases.target: A bound constructible target remains constructible and retains bound arguments while ignoring bound this.
cases.principledRepair: Document bound arguments and construction behavior.
cases.weakRepair: Assume bind always creates a call-only function.

cases.title: Extracted method loses receiver at runtime
cases.target: Reading a method produces a function value; later bare invocation supplies no receiver.
cases.principledRepair: Use explicit this typing, a wrapper, or deliberate binding.
cases.weakRepair: Catch TypeError and retry.

cases.title: Bound prefix arguments remain typed
cases.target: Bind removes supplied receiver and prefix arguments from the callable surface.
cases.principledRepair: Let the type system retain the remaining argument contract.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the bound function to a broad Function.

cases.title: Callable interface is not a constructor
cases.target: A call signature alone does not establish constructibility.
cases.principledRepair: Add an explicit new signature only when construction is meaningful.
cases.weakRepair: Use any or Function.

cases.title: Private brand predicate
cases.target: The declaring class can test its private brand at runtime.
cases.principledRepair: Use the brand predicate to establish legitimate initialization.
cases.weakRepair: Use instanceof as a substitute for every brand question.

cases.title: Private field is inaccessible outside class
cases.target: JavaScript private fields are syntactically and semantically restricted to the declaring class body.
cases.principledRepair: Expose a narrow method or getter if reading is part of the public contract.
cases.weakRepair: Rename it to a normal underscore property.

cases.title: Derived constructor cannot use this before super
cases.target: A derived constructor receives a usable this only after super returns.
cases.principledRepair: Call super before using this.
cases.weakRepair: Suppress the diagnostic.

cases.title: Prototype forgery lacks private brand
cases.target: Prototype delegation does not execute private-field initialization.
cases.principledRepair: Validate plain data and invoke a legitimate factory or constructor.
cases.weakRepair: Set the prototype and assert the class type.

cases.title: Class field initialization order
cases.target: Base fields exist before the base constructor body; derived fields initialize after super returns.
cases.principledRepair: Trace state by construction phase.
cases.weakRepair: Assume all fields exist before any constructor executes.

cases.title: Static private field belongs to constructor
cases.target: Static private state is branded on the constructor object.
cases.principledRepair: Access it through the declaring class contract.
cases.weakRepair: Move it to an exported mutable module variable.

cases.title: Private fields are not structurally interchangeable
cases.target: Distinct private declarations make classes nominally incompatible.
cases.principledRepair: Use a public interface when structural substitution is intended.
cases.weakRepair: Cast B to A.

cases.title: Constructor return type remains instance
cases.target: Ordinary class construction returns a legitimately initialized instance.
cases.principledRepair: Keep reconstruction on the constructor/factory path.
cases.weakRepair: Forge the prototype of decoded data.

cases.title: Narrow capability injection
cases.target: A narrow structural capability grants only the required authority.
cases.principledRepair: Inject the smallest stable operation set.
cases.weakRepair: Pass a broad environment object.

cases.title: Missing capability method is rejected
cases.target: A collaborator must satisfy the required capability.
cases.principledRepair: Provide save with the correct asynchronous contract.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the object to Store.

cases.title: Class cannot extend two bases
cases.target: JavaScript class syntax has one extends lineage.
cases.principledRepair: Compose independent capabilities or use a constrained mixin.
cases.weakRepair: Invent a fake multiple-inheritance cast.

cases.title: Constrained mixin preserves base type
cases.target: A mixin transforms one constructor and returns a derived constructor.
cases.principledRepair: Constrain and document constructor, state, and conflict policy.
cases.weakRepair: Copy methods with Object.assign and ignore state.

cases.title: Composition preserves call order
cases.target: The orchestrator owns operation order while collaborators own separate behavior.
cases.principledRepair: Test authority and exact effect order.
cases.weakRepair: Let dependencies call each other through globals.

cases.title: Copied accessor executes during composition
cases.target: Object.assign reads enumerable source values and does not copy descriptors.
cases.principledRepair: Compose explicit methods or copy reviewed descriptors.
cases.weakRepair: Catch the getter and keep copying blindly.

cases.title: Readonly capability cannot be replaced
cases.target: Readonly composition prevents post-construction collaborator replacement through that reference.
cases.principledRepair: Choose construction-time injection or an explicit reconfiguration authority.
cases.weakRepair: Cast away readonly.

cases.title: Function composition needs compatible stages
cases.target: Ordinary functions are sufficient when identity and lifecycle add no value.
cases.principledRepair: Use the simplest composition that preserves the contract.
cases.weakRepair: Create classes for every stage.

cases.title: Unique symbol property contract
cases.target: A unique symbol can define a collision-resistant structural protocol.
cases.principledRepair: Share the exact symbol identity.
cases.weakRepair: Use the same symbol description to create a new symbol.

cases.title: Different unique symbols are incompatible
cases.target: Symbol descriptions do not determine symbol identity.
cases.principledRepair: Use one exported or module-shared symbol.
cases.weakRepair: Compare descriptions and cast.

cases.title: Iterator protocol is typed
cases.target: Symbol.iterator must return an iterator producing the declared item type.
cases.principledRepair: Implement the standard iterable contract.
cases.weakRepair: Expose a string-named iterate method and expect for-of to find it.

cases.title: Iterator item type mismatch
cases.target: The generator item type must satisfy the iterable item type.
cases.principledRepair: Yield numbers or change the declared protocol honestly.
cases.weakRepair: Cast yielded strings to numbers.

cases.title: Primitive conversion receives a hint
cases.target: Coercion requests a hint and requires a primitive result.
cases.principledRepair: Define meaning per supported hint.
cases.weakRepair: Return one representation for every operation without analysis.

cases.title: Non-primitive conversion result fails
cases.target: Symbol.toPrimitive must return a primitive value.
cases.principledRepair: Return string, number, bigint, symbol, boolean, null, or undefined as appropriate.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the object return type.

cases.title: toStringTag getter returns string
cases.target: Symbol.toStringTag participates in built-in tagging.
cases.principledRepair: Return a stable tag string.
cases.weakRepair: Treat it as a privacy mechanism.

cases.title: Protocol method return type is enforced
cases.target: The declared protocol method must return a permitted primitive type.
cases.principledRepair: Return a supported primitive.
cases.weakRepair: Use any.

cases.title: Repeatable iterable creates generator
cases.target: An iterable can create a fresh iterator for each traversal.
cases.principledRepair: Return new traversal state per call.
cases.weakRepair: Make the container itself a permanently consumed iterator.

cases.title: Iterator result item type mismatch
cases.target: IteratorResult value must satisfy the iterator item type while done is false.
cases.principledRepair: Return a number or change the contract.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the result.

cases.title: Generator return and yield types
cases.target: Generator type parameters distinguish yielded, returned, and resumed values.
cases.principledRepair: Model all three positions when they matter.
cases.weakRepair: Use Generator<any, any, any>.

cases.title: Yielded value violates generator contract
cases.target: Yield expressions must match the declared yield type.
cases.principledRepair: Yield numbers or correct the API.
cases.weakRepair: Assert the string as unknown as number.

cases.title: Early break closes generator
cases.target: for-of calls iterator return on early break, allowing generator finally cleanup.
cases.principledRepair: Place traversal-local cleanup in a finally block.
cases.weakRepair: Assume completion is the only cleanup path.

cases.title: Mutation invalidates traversal
cases.target: A live traversal can reject structural revision changes explicitly.
cases.principledRepair: Capture and compare the relevant revision.
cases.weakRepair: Silently continue over mixed versions.

cases.title: Iterator is not automatically iterable
cases.target: Iterator and Iterable are separate protocols.
cases.principledRepair: Add Symbol.iterator returning the iterator or expose an Iterable.
cases.weakRepair: Cast Iterator to Iterable.

cases.title: IterableIterator satisfies both protocols
cases.target: Generator objects implement both next and Symbol.iterator.
cases.principledRepair: Use the combined interface when single-pass iterability is intended.
cases.weakRepair: Assume every Iterator has Symbol.iterator.

cases.title: Reflect preserves receiver
cases.target: Reflect.get accepts an explicit receiver for accessor semantics.
cases.principledRepair: Forward target, key, and receiver deliberately.
cases.weakRepair: Use target[key] inside a proxy trap and lose receiver behavior.

cases.title: ownKeys trap returns property keys
cases.target: Proxy ownKeys must return strings or symbols.
cases.principledRepair: Return PropertyKey values and preserve target invariants.
cases.weakRepair: Cast number keys.

cases.title: Revocable proxy exposes revoke
cases.target: Proxy.revocable separates the proxy value from terminal revocation authority.
cases.principledRepair: Own the revoke function in a session object.
cases.weakRepair: Expose revoke to every caller.

cases.title: Proxy target retains static shape
cases.target: A generic Proxy retains the target surface statically while runtime traps govern operations.
cases.principledRepair: Implement traps against the actual target contract.
cases.weakRepair: Assume static shape guarantees trap honesty.

cases.title: Private field rejects proxy receiver
cases.target: Method lookup through a proxy calls the method with the proxy receiver, which lacks the target private brand.
cases.principledRepair: Avoid proxying branded instances or define a deliberate receiver-recovery boundary.
cases.weakRepair: Assume an empty proxy is transparent.

cases.title: Proxy cannot hide non-configurable key
cases.target: The proxy invariant requires non-configurable own keys to be reported.
cases.principledRepair: Use a separate redacted view rather than a lying proxy.
cases.weakRepair: Make the target property configurable solely to permit deception.

cases.title: Proxy constructor requires object target
cases.target: A proxy target must be an object or callable object.
cases.principledRepair: Wrap data in an object only when proxy semantics are justified.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the primitive to object.

cases.title: Define-property trap can delegate
cases.target: Reflect.defineProperty returns the Boolean result expected by the trap.
cases.principledRepair: Delegate ordinary semantics and add only bounded validation.
cases.weakRepair: Return true without updating the target.

cases.title: Structured clone preserves typed data shape
cases.target: structuredClone returns a deep data clone typed from its input.
cases.principledRepair: Use it only when its runtime cloning contract matches the domain.
cases.weakRepair: Assume it preserves class prototypes and descriptors.

cases.title: WeakRef requires an object target
cases.target: WeakRef targets must be objects.
cases.principledRepair: Use weak references only for optional object reachability behavior.
cases.weakRepair: Box the number solely to satisfy WeakRef.

cases.title: Disposable contract requires Symbol.dispose
cases.target: A synchronous Disposable exposes Symbol.dispose.
cases.principledRepair: Implement deterministic cleanup on the owning value.
cases.weakRepair: Rely on finalization.

cases.title: Missing disposal method violates contract
cases.target: A Disposable must implement Symbol.dispose.
cases.principledRepair: Add the explicit cleanup method or remove the claim.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the value to Disposable.

cases.title: Structured clone preserves cycle
cases.target: structuredClone preserves graph cycles while creating new object identities.
cases.principledRepair: Use it for supported data graphs, then apply domain reconstruction if needed.
cases.weakRepair: Use JSON for cyclic graphs.

cases.title: JSON cannot clone a cycle
cases.target: JSON serialization rejects cyclic object graphs.
cases.principledRepair: Use a cycle-aware representation or domain codec.
cases.weakRepair: Delete back-references without defining product meaning.

cases.title: Finalization registry held value is explicit
cases.target: Finalization callbacks receive held values but are not deterministic cleanup.
cases.principledRepair: Restrict use to optional diagnostics or cache cleanup.
cases.weakRepair: Use the callback to maintain correctness-critical capacity.

cases.title: Readonly map prevents remapping mutation
cases.target: ReadonlyMap exposes lookup but not mutation authority.
cases.principledRepair: Keep a mutable map inside the clone algorithm and return a readonly view.
cases.weakRepair: Cast away readonly.

cases.title: Readonly view hides mutation authority
cases.target: A readonly public view can omit structural mutation methods.
cases.principledRepair: Return detached/frozen data or a narrow live view.
cases.weakRepair: Expose the internal mutable array.

cases.title: Readonly children reject push
cases.target: Readonly arrays do not expose mutating methods through that capability.
cases.principledRepair: Route mutation through graph authority.
cases.weakRepair: Cast to string[].

cases.title: Exhaustive representation switch
cases.target: A closed representation vocabulary supports exhaustive handling.
cases.principledRepair: Keep live and plain representations distinct.
cases.weakRepair: Use one broad object type.

cases.title: Missing representation branch is visible
cases.target: The remaining debug variant is not never.
cases.principledRepair: Handle the new representation explicitly.
cases.weakRepair: Remove assertNever or cast.

cases.title: Plain persistence loses class behavior
cases.target: JSON reconstructs plain data, not class prototype behavior or private brands.
cases.principledRepair: Validate data and invoke a legitimate reconstruction factory.
cases.weakRepair: Assert the decoded object has the class type.

cases.title: Runtime and record remain separate
cases.target: A deliberate record conversion produces a different runtime representation.
cases.principledRepair: Keep separate types and reconstruction paths.
cases.weakRepair: Persist the live instance directly.

cases.title: Private mutation method stays inaccessible
cases.target: Private graph authority cannot be invoked outside the declaring class.
cases.principledRepair: Expose a validated public transition.
cases.weakRepair: Rename it with an underscore.

cases.title: Protocol capability can be tested safely
cases.target: Runtime capability discovery establishes the iterable protocol before use.
cases.principledRepair: Test the symbol-keyed operation and then consume it.
cases.weakRepair: Assert every object is iterable.
